headline: Your gut does not have to run your diary.
subhead: A medical food built for people living with IBD, made to fit a normal week.
point1body: Designed around the days you cook properly and the days you do not.
point2body: Every batch is the same, so you always know what you are eating.
point3body: Two minutes to prepare, at your desk or at home.
point4body: Formulated against published nutrition research, with the sources linked.
update: Start with one week and see how it sits before you commit to more.
